clips.title: The story
paras: In Westfall, another family is leaving its farm as banditry drives homesteaders from their land. Before departing, Verna Furlbrow entrusts her cherished local recipe to Salma Saldean.

Defias thieves and wild mechanical harvest reapers have driven Verna and Farmer Furlbrow from their family acreage. They pack their wagon and prepare to seek refuge behind Stormwind's walls. Before leaving, Verna gives her neighbor Salma Saldean the recipe for Westfall Stew, hoping the farm's home-cooked tradition will live on.

Salma Saldean and her husband, Farmer Saldean, still hold their homestead just down the road. Verna's recipe marks the loss of another neighbor to the unrest, yet keeps a local farm tradition alive. Salma sets out to gather the ingredients needed to feed those still struggling on the frontier.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I never thought the day would come when I'd leave the farm. But the fields are overrun with thieves and it's far too dangerous for us here now. As soon as Farmer Furlbrow gets the wagon fixed, we'll be on our way.
Maybe you could do me a favor? Let me scribble down my recipe for Westfall stew. Please take it to Salma Saldean over on the farm yonder. The Saldean's farm is just beyond the fork in the road.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much. I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?

clips.title: Completion
paras: That Verna was always such a sweet lass. We'll miss her here in Westfall but between you and me, she's a city girl at heart and Stormwind will suit her just fine. But enough gossip! Now we can make Westfall Stew!
